text: Tick ~120: at start the centre aim hint ('Grimy. Scrub it (2).') is drawn on top of the help text block; both are illegible where they overlap. Also the 'am' after the clock is tiny/clipped at the right edge.
Tick ~120: checklist says 'STEP: Survey' with 'Grime' already ticked before I did anything. Nothing on screen explains what surveying means (look at things? walk inside?).

Tick 2541: Survey done after ~85 game s. Survey is completed by aiming the crosshair at each problem, but nothing says so; the checklist is also drawn over the left part of the floor, which hid the rotten-floorboard patch, and a fallen rafter occluded the window so it would not tick until I walked closer. Arrow-key turning at ~6 fps overshoots a lot (hold Left 0.2s turned ~48 deg).

Ticks 3280-5730: shovelling the single snow drift. The drift shrinks toward its centre as you shovel, so the crosshair falls off it repeatedly and the aim switches to 'Floorboards' with no feedback. The meter said 90-96% while state snow was still 0.04/0.01, and the last few percent took ~70 game seconds of re-aiming at a tiny blob. Expected: the drift to keep a stable hit area, or the job to finish at ~95%.

Ticks 6560-9860: picking up the first piece of debris took ~110 game seconds. Shingles are thin, flat slivers; the crosshair has to be exactly on one, pitch stops at about -75 deg so a piece at your feet (the one walkto put me next to, 0.2 m) cannot be aimed at, and E on nearby debris does nothing unless the crosshair names it. Expected a more generous pick radius for E (nearest debris in front). Also: while carrying, nothing is shown in hand; only the orange 'Carrying' line says so.

Tick ~11760: aiming at a 'Fallen shingle' 1.6 m away, the name shows (slightly dimmer grey) but E silently does nothing because it is out of reach. The only out-of-reach cue is the label colour (grey vs white); no 'too far' message when E fails.

Tick ~22600 (12.5 game min in): clock reads 9:37 pm and the cabin is almost pitch black; debris cannot be seen. The clock ran 9:04 am to 9:37 pm in ~12.5 game minutes, so the first evening arrives before a new player has finished the Clear step. No on-screen prompt suggested the lantern (L) when it got dark.

Tick ~26300: sweeping one spot for 5 s moves 'Sweep the floor' 8% -> 11% and shows a clear orange 'Clean here. Move on.' - good feedback. At this rate the floor alone needs ~30 spots. Also noted: walking out to the wagon during the Clear step offers 'Braided rug - Take it (E)', i.e. furnishings can be taken before the cabin is cleared, with no hint whether that is wise.
